name: Uhuru Park
description: Uhuru Park is a 12.9 hectare recreational park next to Nairobi's central business district. It has an artificial lake, national monuments, and an assembly ground popular for weekend skateboarding.

name: Arboretum
description: Located in Kilimani near the city centre, the Arboretum has 30.4 hectares of wooded landscape and about 350 indigenous and exotic plant species.

name: Case spaces
description: A prestigious, convenient location with excellent visibility and a welcoming setting for customers.

name: Hidden Gardens
description: Enchanting grounds that offer a tranquil, picturesque setting for events and community gatherings.

name: Ikigai spaces
description: The flexible seating arrangement allows our members to choose from standing desks to private booths, from swings to couches and everything in between, either in a quiet corner or in the middle of the action.

name: Oval
description: A contemporary nine-storey mixed-use development with office accommodation, retail, lifts, CCTV, backup power, water storage, parking, and accessibility facilities.

name: GTC Spaces
description: A modern office tower with an elegant, glossy facade, impressive height, and a landmark business setting.

name: Parkside towers
description: A 10-storey Mombasa Road tower with underground and ground parking, around-the-clock surveillance, a Java House, and Airtel 4G/5G.

name: Ebenezer-Spaces
description: An efficient office space for startups and small teams to host focused meetings and discussions.

name: I&M pentspaces
description: A top-floor Nairobi CBD space with sweeping city views, suited to executives who value privacy and luxury.

name: Teja spaces
description: Private offices, business lounges, meeting rooms, coworking spaces, and enterprise solutions in a vibrant ecosystem.

name: Jamhuri show-grounds
description: A large field with ample seating, ideal for concerts, showgrounds, agricultural exhibitions, and food festivals.

name: Nairobi Street Kitchen
description: A collection of restaurants, bars, entertainment areas, artisan vendors, live bands, and rooftop views in Westlands.

name: The Alchemist
description: A lively day-and-night venue for parties, dancing, restaurants, and bars.

name: Mass-house Ngong Racecourse
description: A venue for horse-racing events, relaxed parties, and social gatherings that welcome local and international visitors.
